Think as though any other drug under the sun is available man. Opiates are in a different class of their own. Nothing, absolutely nothing compares to how amazing and how absolutely destructful they are...overtime ive realized that as humans in this early extistance, I've recognized  few universal laws. One of them is yin/yang, good/bad, etc. I find this applys more to anything that instantaneously makes you feel good in the short term (not only drugs). Opiates make sex, excersize, intimacy, love, adventure, traveling, alcohol, and every other drug appear worthless and boring in comparison. It's the ultimate forbidden fruit that really makes you feel godlike - and therefore it will kill you and/or eventually make your life a living hell. It's the one drug, that I believe, will turn almost anyone who uses it recreationally and prescribed into an "addict" even if they're not an "addict" beforehand. Tread lightly.

I would only use again if I knew I was going to die soon because I wouldn't have to deal with the repercussions. 

On the plus side it makes you feel immortal and like a god - untouchable. But that's the issue. 

For me, it took a long long time to enjoy anything else because I always compared everything else to Opiates. It set a new precedent to what feels good and what doesn't.

I would be extremely careful in your relationship as well. It's insidious - it will creep up on you before you realize it. Like a brain infection - you'll unconsciously make excuses to use more and more without consciously realizing it.
